internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rate in Cart Service
internal.body: At 10:27 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate in the cart service, reaching approximately 50%. Initial diagnosis rounds explored hypotheses including dependency unreachability and internal error injection. However, attempts to enable failure flags for deeper diagnosis were blocked by guardrails, leading to replanning and further investigation. The elevated error rate was accompanied by increased latency (p95 around 120 ms), but no direct evidence of resource exhaustion was found. The incident was escalated for further handling. No definitive root cause was confirmed during this phase due to guardrail constraints preventing certain diagnostic actions.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience as we work to resolve the issue.
